title: SDD Spec Context
description: Runtime state file written per spec at specs/{NNN}-{slug}/.spec-context.json. Authored by SDD skills and (optionally) the SpecKit Companion VS Code extension. See docs/STATE.md for the narrative reference.

workflow.description: Workflow identifier. Always "sdd". Set once at spec creation by /sdd:specify.

currentStep.description: The pipeline phase currently in progress. Updated on every step transition by SDD skills; the extension may also write this when it detects step transitions in the spec dir.

currentTask.description: Active task ID during /sdd:implement Phase 1, e.g. "T003". Null outside Phase 1.

progress.description: Substep marker used for precise resume after context loss. Null when between phases. See docs/STATE.md § Substep Enumeration for valid values.

next.description: Hint to /sdd:resume and /sdd:auto for the next skill to invoke. Null when no next step is implied.

updated.description: Last modification date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Bumped on every write (including every drain).

drainedSeq.description: Drain watermark — highest .spec-context.events.jsonl `seq` folded into this file by lib/scripts/drain-spec-context.py. Internal to SDD's event journal; absent or 0 when no journal has been drained. See lib/instructions/event-journal.md.

specName.description: Human-readable feature name. Set once at creation by /sdd:specify.

branch.description: Audit-trail field: the git branch the user was on when /sdd:specify ran. Never updated after creation.

workingBranch.description: Branch SDD actually runs on. Populated when .sdd.json branchStage auto-creates a branch. Null when no auto-creation occurred — readers fall back to `git branch --show-current`.

type.description: Conventional-commit type inferred from the feature description. Used by branchNameFormat ({type} variable) and commit-message generation.

selectedAt.description: ISO timestamp when /sdd:specify selected/created the workflow.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the spec directory was created.

auto.description: True while /sdd:auto is driving the pipeline. Skills read this to suppress manual next-step hints and to render the auto-mode footer instead. Cleared on completion.

paused.description: True after /sdd:pause; cleared by /sdd:resume. Prevents auto-advance through the pipeline.

approach.description: One-line implementation strategy. Written by /sdd:plan on completion; updated by /sdd:implement if the approach drifts. Read by implement at resume to reconstruct context without re-reading plan.md.

decisions.description: Append-only log of non-trivial decisions made during /sdd:implement. Each entry is a short statement (typically with rationale).

concerns.description: Issues flagged during task execution. Surfaced at CP1 (Code Review).

files_modified.description: Deduplicated list of all files actually changed during /sdd:implement. Updated after each task completes; sourced from per-task task_summaries[].files.

last_action.description: One-line summary of the most recent action (typically the last task or group that completed). Used at resume for fast orientation.

loadedDomains.description: Layer 1 domains loaded for this spec — names from .sdd.json#domains or .specs/<dir>/ fallback. Set by /sdd:specify Step 3b; read by /sdd:plan and /sdd:implement. Empty array when no domains matched.

syncedDomains.description: Domains successfully synced at CP3 closure of /sdd:implement. Append-only across resumes.

step_summaries.description: Per-step structured summaries. Each step writes its own object on completion.

key_finding.description: One-line observation about the codebase pattern that most informs implementation.

principles_concerns.description: Conflict count from /sdd:plan Step 2a Principles Check. 0 when no concerns or .sdd/principles.md was not loaded.

domain_concerns.description: Conflict count from /sdd:plan Step 2b Domain Alignment Check. 0 when no concerns or no Layer 1 specs were loaded.

significance_score.description: Step 2c Decision Significance Heuristic score (0–3). Score >= 2 triggers the ADR prompt.

adr_drafted.description: Set by Step 2c. The string '<NNNN>-<slug>' when an ADR was drafted; false when the user declined; omitted when the heuristic did not prompt or the user chose Skip.

approach_summary.description: Deprecated. Duplicates the top-level `approach` field. Validators should warn (not fail) when present; skills strip on rewrite.

task_summaries.description: Per-task summary written by /sdd:implement when each task completes. Keys are task IDs (T###).

checkpointStatus.description: Records which ship gates have completed.

prUrl.description: URL of the PR created by /sdd:implement Step 8. Written in the finalize commit (Step 8b).

prNumber.description: Numeric PR number returned by `gh pr create`.

status.description: Lifecycle field used by tree-view grouping (extension UI). Distinct from `currentStep`. Written by both SDD skills (on ship: "completed") and the extension (on step transitions). Last-writer-wins.

stepHistory.description: Extension-managed: per-step timing. Each key is a step name; value is { startedAt, completedAt }. SDD skills must preserve this (read-then-merge).

transitions.description: Append-only audit log. Every .spec-context.json write appends one entry. See lib/instructions/transition-logging.md for write rules.

Author.description: Identifies which writer authored a transition entry.

substep.description: Substep marker matching the writer's progress value. SDD skills populate this from the `progress` field. Extensions may use additional values.
